differences.current_text: “I have only chosen you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”
differences.source_text: “I have chosen only you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”

differences.current_text: For the Lord, the LORD of Hosts, is he who touches the land and it melts, and all who dwell in it will mourn; and it will rise up wholly like the River, and will sink again, like the River of Egypt.
differences.source_text: For the Lord, GOD of Hosts, is he who touches the land and it melts, and all who dwell in it will mourn; and it will rise up wholly like the River, and will sink again, like the River of Egypt.
